description: Elements that perform actions or have behaviour.
name: ActiveElement

description: A connection between two ports, modelled as a node because in most source metamodels a connector is a first-class element carrying its own name, kind, and metadata. Deliberately not an Element or Port subtype.
name: Connection

description: Anything that can participate in the ownership hierarchy.
name: Element

description: An interaction point exposed by an active element.
name: Port

description: Structural containers such as packages and compositions.

description: A specific way in which an element can fail or malfunction, identified during FMEA. The uuid is the stable MALFUNCTION node identifier.
name: malfunction

description: A safety or quality requirement managed in an external requirements management system (e.g. Jama, DOORS, Polarion). The uuid is the canonical SAFETYREQ node identifier.
name: requirement

description: A review comment attached to any analysis element. Two independent axes: reviewer_verdict (reviewer decision) and author_status (author response). The uuid is the stable REVIEWITEM node identifier.
name: review_item

description: An FMEA-style risk assessment for a failure mode, combining Severity, Occurrence, and Detection ratings to compute a Risk Priority Number (RPN). Inlined inside its parent malfunction. The uuid is the stable RISKRATING node identifier.
name: risk_rating

description: A free-text annotation attached to any analysis or imported element. The graph edge is the sole authoritative link. The uuid is the stable SAFETYNOTE node identifier.
name: safety_note

description: A mitigation, monitoring, or verification task derived from analysis. One task may cover multiple failure modes. The uuid is the stable SAFETYTASK node identifier.
name: safety_task

description: A reusable label attached to any analysis or imported element for categorization, filtering, and batch management. The uuid is the stable TAG node identifier.
